meta.title: How to Play — Bettazoo
meta.description: Learn how to bet P2P on Bettazoo as a Bettor or become a Placer and set the market.

header.title: How to Play
header.subtitle: Bettazoo is a peer-to-peer betting exchange on Web3. No bookmaker. Every bet is matched directly between a Bettor and a Placer, secured on-chain.

bettor.title: Place a Bet
bettor.subtitle: You back an outcome at the best available odds.

step1.title: Connect Your Wallet
step1.desc: Link MetaMask (or any Web3 wallet) and make sure you hold USDT stablecoin. No account registration — your wallet is your identity on Bettazoo.

step2.title: Find the Best P2P Odds
step2.desc: Browse Sports and E-Sports events. Compare real peer-to-peer odds set directly by Placers — no bookmaker margin, no hidden fees, full transparency.

step3.title: Bet & Get Paid Automatically
step3.desc: Your stake is locked in the Smart Contract Escrow. When the match ends, a certified Oracle confirms the result and USDT is sent directly to your wallet — instant, trustless, and automated.

placer.title: Be the Market
placer.subtitle: You don't place bets by hand. You set your rules — which outcomes to back, your odds, your max exposure — and your on-chain book takes the action automatically.

step1.title: Deploy Your Vault
step1.desc: Connect your wallet and create your own isolated on-chain Vault from the Placer Dashboard. Deposit USDT — it stays withdrawable to you alone, always.

step2.title: Set a Strategy, Not a Bet Slip
step2.desc: Pick a margin strategy, choose which events and outcomes to cover, and set risk limits (max exposure, stop-loss, a required cap per bet). The Bettazoo keeper quotes and requotes automatically within those rules — you never place a bet by hand.

step3.title: Complete Compliance
step3.desc: Sign the Liquidity Provision Agreement (one wallet signature) and request a KYC review before your Vault can go active — a one-time step that protects both you and the House.

step4.title: Attract Bettors & Earn the Edge
step4.desc: Your offers appear live in the betting exchange. Share your Placer profile — or go live on stream with the OBS overlay and QR code — to build a following. Earn the margin between your quoted odds and the true probability.

faq.question: What is a Placer?
faq.answer: A Placer runs their own book. You set the strategy and the risk limits; your vault takes the other side of bettors' action on-chain, within the rules you set.

creatorSuite.title: Streaming as a Placer
creatorSuite.body: Every Placer gets a public streaming page at <path1>/placer/[address]</path1> with live chat and your active offers — share it to build a following. Streaming on Twitch, Kick or YouTube from OBS? Add <path2>/overlay/[address]</path2> as a Browser Source for a transparent, always-current widget showing your live liquidity and a QR code viewers can scan to bet in seconds.
